propositions: The tickets branch is 1.04 GiB with 92% consumed by the reconciler's bridge_state cache rather than ticket events, due to unchained bookkeeping fields being rewritten on every pass

Deleting the baseline_advanced_at timestamp and moving last_get_pass rotation bookkeeping to a separate file reduces marginal packed cost per version from 12.79 KB to approximately 1.74 KB, a 7.4x improvement

The reconciler must commit bridge_state to branch because it runs on ephemeral GitHub runners, so durability requires git storage; making the cache cheap through selective field removal and moving churn to separate files is the solution

A one-time history rewrite using git fast-export/fast-import can reclaim ~1 GiB of historical repository space by removing legacy versions of target files while preserving all commits and producing byte-identical HEAD tree

Text-normalized baseline description/status/priority (excluding assignee) and narrowed prev_snapshot.json to key-set-only with forward/reverse corpus diffs ensure content changes do not lose Jira mutation information
